name: Vera Health
long_description: Vera Health is a medical search engine built to reason like a clinician. It finds the evidence first, grades it with a framework built alongside the physicians who write practice guidelines, and shows the source, strength and limits behind every answer, in seconds. Designed exclusively for healthcare professionals, Vera is used by more than 800,000 clinicians, including more than one in four doctors in Italy and Spain.
one_liner: Medical search engine built to reason like a clinician.
